title: Real digital-rights and surveillance discourse to ground the 'Digital Rebellion' trilogy and the knowledge-platform
question: Which real-world digital-rights movements, surveillance/data-protection debates (incl. German Netzpolitik, CCC, GDPR-era privacy discourse), and digital-literacy content should the trilogy's 'Digital Rebellion' premise and the endia.de knowledge-platform draw on for plausible worldbuilding and educational quality?
why_now: The trilogy's core theme is a digital rebellion, the project role is a knowledge-platform, and the ADR explicitly notes the document contains no real-world scholarly claims about Endia — so the fiction currently floats without grounding in the very discourse it presumably depicts.
